name: Target-guided Point-Focus Adapter
target_visibility: Designated target layer alpha times all nearer-layer transmittances; metadata identifies the same source object on each frame
click_region: Visible alpha>0.9; if empty >0.5; if empty >0; largest8-connected component; zero-padded exact Euclidean distance; ties row-major
A: Maximal interior distance, independent of predicted depth
B_diagnostic_only: Native PNG8 depth nearest safe-region median; ties maximal interior distance then row-major
unavailable: Mark focus_point_unavailable; no substitution, propagation, smoothing or exclusion policy before inventory
depth: Official DAdepth.pth from RGB, original per-image normalization and PNG8 truncation; no GT depth supplied to generator
focus: Native predicted PNG8 depth at one click /255
K: Benchmark K4/8/16/32 unchanged; abs(predicted_depth-focus)*K/32; native focused condition<=0.1
prompt_reason: Original official demo prompt, used equally for all three preflight candidates; previous native batch Table3 uses empty prompt
generator: Unchanged author FP16 model;512px tiles, stride256, overlap reconstruction, original PIL/AdaIN conversion
RNG: Seed42+25*manifest_scene_index+frame_index for every frame; same seed across candidates, independent of shard/order, no temporal smoothing
coverage_and_leakage: Visible target alpha>0.5; GPU native focused mask; complement defines non-target; report separately byK
selection: A preferred; B diagnostic, no PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS or bokeh-GT based selection; inspect correct visible click, margins, native control coverage/leakage and finite outputs
full_run_start: After5000-frame visibility inventory,40-frame three-candidate review and explicit recorded adapter freeze; preserve all failures and information permissions
